verses.text: Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch pichul winh yik kusk'olal, ix b'at winh t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ix chekjikot winhaj Eliaquim chi', winhaj Sebna chi' yet' heb' sakerdote te icham winakxo yuj winhaj Ezequías chi', ayoch pichul ya swa yuj heb', ix kot heb' t'ayin schekab' in Jehová, a inton Isaías in tik.

Ix ul yalan heb' tas ix yal winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a heb', ix yalan heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ha tiknaik, ayonh och t'a kusk'olal, t'a syaelal yet' t'a q'uixwelk'olal. Icha wal junok ix ix wan yalji yune', tz'el yip ix, icha chi' kaji.

Komonok wal ix yab' Jehová ko Diosal, juntzanh lolonel ix yal jun winh yajalil heb' soldado ix schekkot winh sreyal Asiria chi', yik tzul b'uchwaj winh t'a ko Diosal pitzannhej. Komonok wal sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj Jehová ko Diosal, yuj tas ix yal winh chi'. Ha tiknaik lesalwanh kuj a onh ixto onh kan tik, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.
Ayik ix wab'an tas ix yal heb' schekab' winh rey chi',
ix walan t'a heb' to sb'at yal heb' t'a winh rey chi' tas ix aj yalan Jehová. Ix walan icha tik: Manh ach xiw t'a juntzanh b'uchwal lolonel ix ul yal winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'ayin.

Ha in ol wak'b'at junok komon ab'ix t'a skal heb'. Ayik ol yab'an jun ab'ix jun winh rey chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab' yet' masanil soldado. Ha t'a schonhab' winh chi' ol wak' miljokchamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.

Haxo ix yab'an jun winh yajalil heb' soldado chi' to a winh sreyal Asiria chi' toxo ix el winh t'a chonhab' Laquis, yuj chi' ix meltzaj winh, ix b'at winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' ayik wan yak'an owal winh t'a chonhab' Libna.

Hata' ix yab' winh rey chi' to a winhaj Tirhaca sreyal Etiopía wan skot yet' jantak soldado yak' owal yet' winh. Yuj chi' ix stz'ib'ankot scheknab'il winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi', syalan icha tik:
Ha a Diosal tzak'och yipok a k'ol chi', ha' ol ach kolan t'a yol in k'ab' a naani, palta manh a cha ach yak' musansatil.
Ix ab'i tas ix kutej ko satanel juntzanh heb' rey yet' schonhab' a onh sreyal onh Asiria tik. ¿Tom a achto wal ol ach kolchajkanok?
¿Tokwal ix kolchaj heb' anima yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' in mam wicham? Nakot tas ajnak chonhab' Gozán, Harán, Resef yet' heb' aj Edén, haton heb' kajan t'a Telasar.
Nakot tas utajnakpax winh sreyal Hamat, Arfad, Sefarwaim, Hena yet' Iwa. Icha chi' ix yutej winh rey chi' stz'ib'ankot scheknab'il.
Ix schaanek' jun tas ix stz'ib'ejkot winh rey chi' winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix yawtan winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a templo, ix b'at yak'anoch lechan winh t'a yichanh Jehová,
ix lesalwi winh icha tik:
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, ha t'a snanhal heb' querubín ayach eq'ui. Ha achnhej Dios ach t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha ach a b'onak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik.
Mamin, komonok tza maklej wal ab'i. Ina wal juntzanh lolonel ix stz'ib'ejkot winhaj Senaquerib tik t'ayin, haton juntzanh b'uchwal lolonel ix yal winh tik t'a a patik, ach Dios to pitzan achnhej.
Yelton wal Mamin Jehová, a heb' winh sreyal Asiria chi' ix satanel juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix yixtankanb'at slum heb' winh.
Ix snhusantz'a masanil sdiosal heb' winh, yujto a juntzanh chi', wal yel manh diosok, yujto b'ob'il yuj anima, nab'a plata, ma te', ma k'een. Yuj chi' ix yal satanel heb' winh.
Ha tiknaik jun Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, kolonhel t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', yik syojtakejel masanil nakión to a achnhej Dios ach, xchi winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in chekan a in Isaías in tik b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Ezequías chi' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik: Toxo ix wab' a lesal ix al t'ayin yuj winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria, xchi.

Yuj chi' ix yalan juntzanh lolonel tik Jehová t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Asiria chi': Ach Senaquerib, a heb' ix kob'estak aj Sion, tonhej tzach stzetzej heb' ix. Ha heb' aj Jerusalén, tonhej ol b'at mikiljok heb' ach sb'uchani ayik elelalxonhej ol ach meltzajok.
¿Mach jun b'aj ix a komon tek'b'ej a b'a a b'uchani? ¿Mach jun b'aj ix komon k'e wal a jaj ix ik'anchaanh a b'a t'ay? Haton wal t'ayin a in sDiosal in Israel to Ha inxonhej Ochi.

Ix a chekanpaxkot heb' a chekab' yik tzik'an wal chaanh a b'a, ix ul yalan heb' t'ayin icha tik: Yet' wal jantak in karruaje yik owal in k'ek'och t'a sjolom lum witz te chaanh t'a yol yik Líbano. Ix in ch'akem te' k'ute' chaanh steel yet' te' taj te wach' yilji. Ix in k'ek'och t'a lum jolomtak witz te chaanh b'aj k'ayum te te'.
Yalnhej b'aj syal in joyan ha' uk'b'ila' wuk'ej. Syal wek'nhej t'a ha ha' t'a Egipto, ichato tupnak ha', malaj mach syal in syamanoch waan, xa chi ix ik'an wal chaanh a b'a.

¿Tom manh ojtakok to a in Jehová in swak'elk'och masanil juntzanh chi'? Atax t'a peka' nab'il wuuj to ol ujok juntzanh chi', haxo tiknaik swak'elk'ochi. Yuj chi' ix yal a satanel juntzanh chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal, toxonhej ix k'ekan b'ulan sk'ajil uuj.

Ha heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix te xiwkank'e heb', ix q'uixwikank'e heb'. Lajan ix ajkan heb' icha anh ank'ultak yax latz'inak, ma icha anh ank'ultak sq'uib'k'e t'a yib'anhtak pat, stakji yuj ik' skot b'aj sjawi k'u.
Wojtaknhej b'ajtak tzach eq'ui yet' tastak tza k'ulej. Wojtak to ix kot wal owal t'ayin.
Wojtak jantak owal, jantak wal ak'umtakil, yuj chi' ol wak'och jun k'een argolla t'a a nhi' yet' jun freno t'a a ti', ol ach wak'an meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ach koti, xchi Jehová.

Haxo t'ayach ach Ezequías, ay jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová eyila'. Ha t'a jun ab'il tik yet' t'a junxo, ol he wa sat ixim trigo munil ol pak'k'e sch'okoj. Haxo t'a yoxil ab'il, a exxo ol eyawej eyiko', ol he molan sat tas ol eyawej chi'. Ol eyawej te' uwa, ol he loan sat te'.
Ha jaywanh ex ixto ex kan t'a Judá tik, lajan ol ex aj icha junok te te' tz'awchaji sb'at sch'anhal yib', elanhchamel satani.
Ha exxo jaywanh ex ixto ex kan t'a Jerusalén, t'a tzalan Sion tik, a ex ol eyak'xi b'ut'jokel ko chonhab' tik. Icha chi' ol ajok yujto xajan onh yuj Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Haxo pax yuj winh sreyal Asiria jun, ix yal Jehová icha tik: Manh ol och winh t'a Jerusalén tik, malaj junok yol sjul-lab' winh ol sjuleli. Manh ol och winh yak' owal t'ay yet' maklab' jul-lab'. Manh ol sb'ok'e stek'nub' winh t'a spatiktak smuroal chonhab' tik.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala', ha t'a b'e b'aj ol kot winh, hanheja' ta' ol meltzaj winh. Manh ol yal yoch winh t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ol in tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, ol in kolani, yujto tzin xajanej winh in chekab' aj David yet' pax sniwanil Welk'ochi, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ha Yángel Jehová ix k'och t'a skampamento heb' aj Asiria chi', ix smilancham 185 mil heb' soldado. Chamnakxo heb' ix q'uinhib'i t'a junxo k'u.
Yuj chi', ix yik'el skampamento winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria chi', ix pax winh t'a chonhab' Nínive.

Ay jun k'u ayik wan slesalwi winh t'a stemplo sdiosal skuch Nisroc, haxo heb' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Adramelec yet' winhaj Sarezer, ix b'at milancham winh ta'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' winh elelal t'a yol yik Ararat. Haxo winhaj Esar-hadón, junxo yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
